title: The boss lab's bait mode sits in the game's own gunship seat (thermal, the GROUND TRUTH monitor, the game's HUD, keys and sounds) and the MK-9's perPass is a count, 0 for no limit
context: Owner, 2026-10-09, after trying the bait mode: "why are we re-inventing the wheel? just re-use the EXACT Same views from the Gunship in the main game; a) thermal, b) smaller ground view on the bottom right. c) same sound effects, etc. except we want multiple nukes." Spec and plan docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-09-boss-bait-game-seat-design.md. Built on the unpushed branch refactor-run in three commits: 663948f5 perPass as a count (src/domain/gunship.js, test/gunship.mjs); ce52eb81 the lab's cell side named; b81fb8d1 the game seat in the lab (src/labs/boss/game-seat.js; src/labs/boss/seat.js removed). The bait mode's own entries (2026-10-09-boss-bait-mode-design, 2026-10-09-boss-bait-mode-landed) stand for Isao, the fight, the cards and the pyrrhic rule; this replaces only their seat.
outcome: THE SEAT IS THE GAME'S: in bait mode the lab instantiates src/sentry-pilot.js createSentryPilot with a lab host (src/labs/boss/game-seat.js, the lab's td-tab.js), so its pose, lens, zoom, keys (1 2 3, V, T, P, Space, pointer lock, the wheel), the KORP HUD and every sound cue are the game's; the FLIR (src/fx/flir-pass.js) runs through a small post chain built like src/postfx.js's (the scene, the OutputPass, the FLIR last), the heat (src/fx/thermal-heat.js) warms the creature and makes Isao and the MK-9 hot, and src/fx/story-monitor.js draws the GROUND TRUTH monitor bottom right after the main view as td-tab.js does (it rides the MK-9 while one falls). The seat is mounted only in bait mode (not in the free orbit) and disposed on leaving it; Esc goes back to the tank, P pauses the lab's clock, R restarts through a capture listener the lab registers before any seat (sentry-pilot.js unchanged). THE UNITS: the lab's scene is in metres (a cell is planet.cellSide x planet.radius = planet.cellMetres = 10.000, STORY_RECIPE.metresPerCell by construction; the literal 10s were right and are now the named CELL). The game's seat, optic, MK-9 body and monitor work on the unit sphere with the planet's centre at the origin (the monitor's camera has its far plane at 50 units), so while the seat is mounted the lab's scene is scaled by 1/radius and lifted by one, the seat's parts live in a group scaled by the radius, the camera takes the game's near and far, the lights' targets are in the scene, and the lattice is the lab planet's own graph indexed by src/cellindex.js; measured, the platform rides 340.00 m over the ground (34 cells of 10 m). Explosions size their puffs in view space, so in the game's units the seat spawns them from its own instance (the lab's arena and Isao's end go through it while it is mounted); the first try spawned them in metres under the scaled scene and a Bofors burst washed the whole optic. THE RULES: every round the game seat fires lands through the boss fight (src/labs/boss/friendlies.js resolve: the landing and burn paths that tell the fear, Isao and the arena): a 25 mm round burns the fight's rotary footprint for 1/30 s where it lands (one hit a burst), a 40 mm round and the MK-9 land with the fight's radius and damage; the friendlies draw no ring of their own for them (the game seat's rings and tracers are the only ones). The HUD's In blast and the MK-9's DANGER CLOSE name ISAO when the selected gun's ring is on him (G.bodies() is Isao, as the game's own). The platform holds over the middle of the creature and Isao and creeps toward it at the game's top ground speed only beyond the game's loiter radius (80 m), so a held aim stays where it was put. MULTIPLE NUKES: src/domain/gunship.js perPass counts the gunner's releases in a pass (heavyCount), 0 is no limit, the automated round still never follows any of the gunner's; the game's content keeps one a pass and its 20 s reload (node test). The lab's copy sets perPass 0 and its reload from the fight folder's knob `MK-9 reload (s)`, default 6; each release still waits out its 4.2 s fall and the reload. The monitor's CSS is scoped by .gunship-seat (the game's #tab-td and the lab's stage both carry it; the game's box unchanged, --gunship green); the lab's CSS puts the seat's HUD over the stage, not the window, and the readout and the monitor left of its panel. FOUND IN THE GAME (not changed): GUNSHIP_AUTO.nukeCalls `gunship_nuke_call` and `gunship_nuke_hello` have no sound key in the manifest and no file in assets, so the automated gunship's nuke callout is silent (src/fx/gunship-auto.js plays it only when the cue exists): a game bug for the owner. DROPPED with the lab's seat: Isao's cyan screen-space ring and tag (the game's seat has none; in thermal he is hot white and the HUD warns when a ring is on him) and the WASD pan.
alternatives: Keep the lab's own seat (src/labs/boss/seat.js) and copy the game's thermal and monitor into it: rejected by the owner (re-inventing the wheel).

Reuse src/fx/gunship-rig.js as is: not possible without changing it; its bag reads the game's GUNSHIP_GUNS (the lab needs perPass 0 and the reload knob) and its host is the game's board (story, dungeon, towers, the strike). The lab steps the same pieces in the same order instead.

Keep the lab's scene in metres and the seat in a group scaled by the radius: the seat and the monitor would work but the monitor's own camera (far plane 50, not reachable) clips the ground at 50 m; the scene takes the game's units while the seat is mounted instead.
Model the 25 mm as the fight's instant stream: rejected; the rounds are the game's (thirty a second, two seconds of flight, the overheat), resolved at their landing.

A platform that follows the action continuously: rejected after the first run; the moving platform carried the aim and nudged a falling MK-9 off its lead (the game's one nudge follows the aim's cell).
evidence: node test/gunship.mjs: the game keeps one a pass and its 20 s reload; perPass 3 releases three then is spent and counts afresh next pass; perPass 0 releases six in one pass and still waits out the fall and the reload; the automated gunship holds its fire once the gunner has fired (npm test 219 programs green at each commit)
